    return (p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P*np.log(P)+p[4]+p[5]*t+p[6]*P*s+p[7]*P*c+p[8]*s+p[9]*c+p[10]*P**3)
def res(p): return mk(p)-dP_dt

for w0 in np.linspace(0.3,0.6,10):
    p0=np.r_[w0,np.random.randn(10)*0.5]
    r=least_squares(res,p0)

print(best.x.round(4), np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
